_comment: Gate replay 4 (M3): duck overlap on the music bus. boss1_spawn at tick 20 opens the duck (attack 16000-18400, duck_end 42400); a second boss at tick 40 lands inside the hold and must be a PURE EXTENSION (duck_end -> 58400, NO new fade - one pending fade slot per node); the single release issues from update() at the extended end (58400, done 68000); a third boss at tick 76 arrives mid-release and re-attacks from current volume (beg=-1), duck_end 87200, final release 87200->96800. group_fade_at on bus_music == 4 is the contract: attack, release, re-attack, final release - a 5th line means the extension re-issued, a 3rd missing means the re-attack was swallowed. 1500 Hz spacing is always coherent (25 cycles/tick); 400 Hz ratio windows discriminate each phase against the counterfactual.
name: replay_duck_overlap

ratio._extension_holds: past the FIRST duck_end (42400): without the extension the release would already be recovering here (~0.87)

ratio._reattack_holds: release1 ended at 68000; 1.0 here means boss 3's mid-release re-attack was swallowed

log._the_overlap_contract: attack, single extended release, re-attack, final release
